lines.zh: 花瓣落在水面，我跟着游。
lines.en: Petals land on the water and I follow them.
The shallows of the cherry brook are warm.
I cross the flower shadows, scales tinged pink.
A layer of fallen blossoms carpets the bed.

lines.zh: 我轻轻摆尾，不想搅浑水。
lines.en: I beat my tail gently, unwilling to stir silt.

lines.zh: 山泉从樱花林里流下来。
lines.en: A spring runs down out of the cherry grove.
I weave between the roots of the trees.

lines.zh: 上游有香味，我往那边去。
lines.en: Something sweet lies upstream, so I head there.

lines.zh: 同伴不在，这条溪只有我。
lines.en: No kin here; this brook holds only me.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水纹很缓。
lines.en: The water I leave behind ripples gently.
Swimming against the petals makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 浅水里能看见我的影子。
lines.en: In the shallows my shadow is plain to see.
Spring water is clear, so I see far.

lines.zh: 又一片花落在我的背上。
lines.en: Another blossom settles on my back.

lines.zh: 我顺着花落的节奏摆尾。
lines.en: I beat my tail to the rhythm of falling petals

lines.zh: 树影在水面上晃，我在下面。
lines.en: Tree shadows shift on the surface, and I am beneath

lines.zh: 樱花瓣落进水里，我贴着花瓣游。
lines.en: Petals fall on the water; I swim along them.
The stream bends, and so do I

lines.zh: 我停在花影里，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I rest in the flower shade, breathing slowly.
Pink petals drift across the surface.
A faint light clings to my body.
The nearby fish have all slowed down.
I rest my head against the water weeds.
Fallen blossoms hide the patterns on my scales.
The water is soft enough to sleep by.
I hold my mouth open for falling insects.
This water is quiet, almost sweetly so.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串小泡，慢慢升。
lines.en: I release bubbles and watch them climb.
Cherry petals do not sink when they land.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让光照着侧腹。
lines.en: I turn so the light warms my flank.
A deer comes to drink and I stay still.
Calm like this is rare for me.

lines.zh: 你蹲在溪边，我先看见手。
lines.en: You crouch at the brook; I notice your hands first.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，正对着你的脸。
lines.en: I rise and come level with your face.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，花瓣都晃了。
lines.en: You are so close the petals tremble.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，这里没什么可怕。
lines.en: I do not fear people; nothing here is fearful.

lines.zh: 你的眼里映着满树粉花。
lines.en: The pink blossoms fill the reflection in your eyes.
I circle the spot where you stand.

lines.zh: 你身上没有河水的味道。
lines.en: There is no river smell on you.

lines.zh: 我停在浅水里，抬头看你。
lines.en: I stop in the shallows and look up at you.
You watch me a long while and I hold still.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，又回到你面前。
lines.en: I circle once and come back in front of you.
I flip over and lose a pink scale.
The pain dims the light along my sides.
I hide in the gap between the roots.
The petals around me are turning red.
My shaking wrinkles the whole brook.
That blow sends me down to the bed.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，只冒出几个泡。
lines.en: I gape and only a few bubbles rise.
I press to the weeds and catch my breath.
My flank aches in long, hot waves.
The quiet of this place is broken now.
You hold a small insect between your fingers.
That smell cuts through the flowers, sharply.
I swim right under your hand.
The insect wriggles and I fix on it.
I open my mouth, afraid of startling you.
A petal blocks my view, so I go around.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度传进水里。
lines.en: The warmth of your palm reaches the water.
I nudge the insect with my snout.
Once in my mouth, it tastes sweet.
I want one more, and then one more.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里，碰到我。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water and touches me.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，粉鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: I shudder and a pink scale comes loose.
The bucket is narrow and my fins press it.
Once you step back, the brook clears.

lines.zh: 我撞在你靴子上，反而愣了。
lines.en: I bump your boot and end up startled.

lines.zh: 花瓣被我们搅得满溪都是。
lines.en: Our movement scatters petals down the brook.

lines.zh: 我用脑袋轻轻顶了顶你。
lines.en: I nudge you gently with my head.

lines.zh: 你身上有灰，蹭到我鳞上。
lines.en: Ash from you rubs onto my scales.
I swim off, and not out of fear.
The surface shakes and the reflections blur.

lines.zh: 春天到了，我身上的光亮了。
lines.en: Spring comes and the light on my body brightens.
She too glides out of the flower shade.
We circle the tree roots side by side.
I brush her with my flank, lightly.
A blossom falls between the two of us.
The brook warms up, and the timing is right.

lines.zh: 我们一同沉到根须下面。
lines.en: Together we sink beneath the root hairs.
The light on her scales settles me.
After summer this brook will feel empty.
We meet only in these two seasons.
A cherry blossom drops into my mouth.
I hold it and do not swallow.
A wild berry lies below, so I take it.
The thing glitters, and it is lovely.
I push it upstream with my mouth.
No kin here to share, so I keep it.
It is slick and slides out of my mouth.
I tuck it away under the roots.
I do not eat the petals I gather.

lines.zh: 我推着它游了半个溪湾。
lines.en: I push it halfway around the bend.
The surface shakes and petals scatter.
Something comes rushing down the current.
A dragonfly has settled on the weeds.
I catch the movement on the bank.

lines.zh: 一条水蛇游进这片浅滩。
lines.en: A water snake has entered these shallows.
I flatten low along the sandy bed.
It sits in the flower shade, badly placed.

lines.zh: 我记住了它落脚的石头。
lines.en: I mark the stone it landed on.
This far out, one dash gets me there.
I hold still and pick it out first.
I slip around to its downstream side.

lines.zh: 花瓣挡着视线，我调整角度。
lines.en: Petals block my view, so I change angle.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我就跟一点。
lines.en: Each time it moves, I close slightly.

lines.zh: 水流往我这边，正好借力。
lines.en: The current runs my way; I borrow it.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的动作，一下一下数。
lines.en: I watch its movements and count each one.
It relaxes and stops watching this side.
One inch closer and I will strike.
My colors hide inside the flower shade.

lines.zh: 樱花的影子落在它背上。
lines.en: Cherry shadows fall across its back.

lines.zh: 我很有耐心，比它想的多。
lines.en: I am more patient than it expects.
I rush in and take hold with my teeth.
It flips to flee and I shove it back.
The splash sends petals flying.
I bite its fin and shake my head.
It is larger, so I hit its flank first.

lines.zh: 我们缠在一起，滚进花丛。
lines.en: We tangle and roll into the fallen flowers.

lines.zh: 我身上的光这时候最亮。
lines.en: My light burns brightest at moments like this.
It retreats and I chase it two feet.
When it ends, the brook runs pink.
I rarely fight, but I can.
I open my eyes in the cherry brook.
Fallen blossoms cover me completely.
Spring water is shallow, barely enough to swim.
The light on my body glows for the first time.
The tree above me is in full bloom.
One brook, and only me in it.

lines.zh: 我试着顺水走了一小段。
lines.en: I try swimming a little way downstream.
The water is neither cold nor hot.

lines.zh: 有片花瓣落在我头上的水里。
lines.en: A petal lands in the water above my head.

lines.zh: 这片林子，闻起来是甜的。
lines.en: This grove smells sweet all around me.

lines.zh: 溪水烫起来，花瓣卷了边。
lines.en: The brook heats up and petals curl.

lines.zh: 我摔在浅滩上，弹了两下。
lines.en: I land in the shallows and bounce twice.
Somehow I choke, right here in the water.
The whole brook is thrown into surges.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过花瓣射中我。
lines.en: An arrow comes through the petals and finds me.

lines.zh: 咒文让我身上的光乱闪。
lines.en: A spell makes my light flicker wildly.
No insects left, and my swimming weakens.

lines.zh: 雷劈在溪边，我全身僵住。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the bank and stiffens me.
The flower shade is gone; only black remains.
